name: FPS Optimizer Pro
description: FPS Optimizer Pro 2.0: live FPS/frame-time overlay, low-graphics preset, and configurable visual reduction tools.

show-fps.name: Show FPS Counter
show-fps.description: Shows a live FPS counter at the upper-left during gameplay.

reduce-particles.name: Performance Mode: Reduce Particles
reduce-particles.description: Hides particle systems during gameplay to reduce visual rendering load. This may remove some visual effects.

fps-update-interval.name: Counter Update Interval
fps-update-interval.description: How often the displayed FPS value refreshes.

low-graphics-mode.name: LOW GRAPHICS PRESET
low-graphics-mode.description: Hides background, ground layers and particle effects while playing. Overrides individual visibility toggles.

hide-background.name: Hide Background
hide-background.description: Hides the level background during gameplay.

hide-ground.name: Hide Ground
hide-ground.description: Hides the main ground layer during gameplay.

hide-ground-2.name: Hide Second Ground Layer
hide-ground-2.description: Hides the secondary ground layer during gameplay.

show-frame-time.name: Show Frame Time (ms)
show-frame-time.description: Displays estimated milliseconds per frame beside FPS.

fps-counter-scale.name: FPS Counter Size
fps-counter-scale.description: Changes the on-screen FPS counter size.

adaptive-fps-colors.name: Adaptive FPS Colors
adaptive-fps-colors.description: Green for high FPS, yellow for medium FPS, red for low FPS.

show-performance-status.name: Show Performance Status
show-performance-status.description: Adds a simple GOOD / FAIR / LOW status label to the counter.

hide-particles-in-practice.name: Reduce Particles in Practice Mode
hide-particles-in-practice.description: Allows particle reduction to be used while playing practice mode too.

fps-green-threshold.name: Green FPS Threshold
fps-green-threshold.description: FPS values at or above this number are shown as green.

fps-yellow-threshold.name: Yellow FPS Threshold
fps-yellow-threshold.description: FPS values at or above this number are shown as yellow, unless they meet the green threshold.
